floorplan_note: STEWARD-HBMe/IDX 10-23 r9b (coordinator tile review 10-23: r8 BAD = 778x648 at 6-8% fill, logic blob at the bottom centre, tx on the N face away from idx_ctl). Outline from the pin bound and content: S 2,392 in-bits at 4.6/um and E 2,205 out-bits at 5.15/um over the 4 macro rows; content 8 SRAMs (129k um2 with halos) + ~30k um2 placed std. Fits the 650 x 500 die slot (no slot change). 4 macro rows l (pitch 105.84) = bank l (left, MY, pin edge to the centre) + bank l+4 (right, R0, pin edge to the centre); tx flit l = rg ? bank l+4 : bank l leaves through the gap above row l to the E face beside row l (tx[545l+:545] over E 50.76 + 105.84 l). S band 0-59.4 = input pin flops + S1 group compaction. FB: wider centre column 186.6 um for the S2-S5 crossbar.

fill_reason.pin_bound: S 2,392 input bits (4.6/um) and E 2,205 output bits (5.15/um over the macro rows) need >= 520 x 450; 8 SRAMs 129k um2 with halos; std ~30k um2 -> ~20% of the free area is the pin-bound consequence.

safe_design_checklist.1_pins: RTL registers every data input/output at the pin (one kept flop, +1/+1); io_flop_at_pins FIRMs them at the S/E faces. The ~940 tx bits without a register are CONSTANT flit pad/header bits (4 x (8 x 28 + 9)) driven by tie cells, not data.
safe_design_checklist.2_reach: S band -> centre <= ~300 um; centre read mux -> E band through the row gap <= ~250 um; write regs at macro pins.
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: RTL byte-identical596d3557d SAFE2; original mapped native<=32, new gate decides.
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: Existing pipelined count/rotate/compact carry unchanged; exact physical gate setup still required.
safe_design_checklist.5_storage: Same 8 real 64x512 SRAMs, 2 x 4 lattice, every macro's W pin edge (rd 288 + wd 266) faces the centre column.
safe_design_checklist.6_floorplan: 596.16x492.48 pin-bound outline inside the die slot; no empty half; rows aligned with tx flits; low_fill_reason pin-bound.
safe_design_checklist.7_clock: Existing symmetric centre-node spine on compact enlarged tile; must pass actual TT/FF spread<=80 and boundary matched, no insertion waiver.
safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: Exact same RTL source/parameters and historical +5 edges; source bench3072records/miter1954 and four causal negatives retained; reset2 unchanged.
